Up from 15% a year earlier. The hunt flagged that H2 needed about 31% for the old FY margin plan, so 27% in Q3 is below that path.

key_line.detail: Raised to $145m from at least $140m. The hunt put the street about $7m below $140m and pricing a cut, so this is a raise against a bar that feared a cut. The FY gross margin guide is at least 28%. Implied Q4 revenue is about $43.3m (my arithmetic: $145m minus 9-month revenue of $101.7m).

guidance.detail: FY revenue $145m (from at least $140m), gross margin at least 28%, net loss under $10m, Adj. EBITDA at least $2.5m, capex under $10m.

call.detail: The call was this morning at 08:30 ET, not last night, so the pre-market has had only about 45 minutes to read it. I found no transcript or summary of the call in the time available. On the tape, the after-hours price was -6.2% and the pre-market recovered to +1.4% by 09:12, which suggests the call helped.

public_reaction.summary: I found no analyst action, price target change or wire headline dated this morning. The consensus target in the low $20s (Investing.com, MarketBeat) is undated and not a reaction.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 9.30 (+1.4%) against prev close 9.17. Last print 09:15 at 9.36; pre-market range 8.80-9.45. 108 prints, 17 in the last 30 minutes, last print 09:12, not stale. After hours 8.60 (-6.2%), so the overnight read was negative and the pre-market turned it after the 08:30 call. The pre-market slipped slightly from its 9.45 high. QQQ +1.9% and IWM +0.9% carry part of the move. +1.4% is far below my +8% release read and the 13.2% implied move. The position is up about 2.5% against the 9.07 entry.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was that the $140m guide sat above a street pricing a cut. The guide was raised to $145m and revenue beat by about 9%. The margin risk the judges named is partly live: Q3 was at 27%, below the 31% H2 path.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is active and not stale, so the open should hold it, but the move is small (+1.4%) and a few cents of noise move it past half. The call ended under an hour before the open and the stock is heavily shorted with a strong tape, so the first half hour leans up rather than fading. That is why p_fade is below the usual base rate for a gap.

recommendation.limit_basis: About +7.4% against the 9.17 close: close to my +8% release read and a little over half the 13.2% implied move. This is a level a 15.6%-short name can touch in a session with QQQ up 1.9%. It sits above the 9.36 pre-market last, on the long's side.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn goed: omzet ruim boven verwachting en de jaarprognose verhoogd naar 145 miljoen. Toch staat het aandeel voorbeurs maar ongeveer 1,4% hoger, en de toelichting voor beleggers was pas om 08:30, dus de markt heeft het nieuws nog niet volledig verwerkt. Zet daarom een verkooplimiet op 9,85; wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot weg.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Zakt de voorbeurskoers vóór 09:30 terug onder 9,00 (onder het slot van gisteren), verkoop dan gewoon bij de opening.
